 What we deliver 
Sub-services tailored to your stage
 

Each cloud & devops engagement is shaped by the problem in front of us — these are the lanes we typically work in.

 
 
 
 
  
 
 
Cloud Migration
 
Move your systems to the cloud securely
 
 
Lift, refactor, or rebuild — depending on what your workload actually needs. We migrate production systems with a zero-downtime cutover plan, a parallel run, and a clean rollback path if anything goes sideways.
 
     
  • AWS, GCP, Azure, and Cloudflare
  • Zero-downtime cutover with parallel run
  • Cost and right-sizing assessment
  • Networking, IAM, and secrets migration
    •  
  
 
  
 
 
CI/CD Pipelines
 
Automated testing and deployment
 
 
We build pipelines that catch the bug, not the developer. Type-check, lint, test, scan, sign, and deploy on every commit — with progressive rollouts, automatic rollback on regressions, and a one-click revert when things go wrong.
 
     
  • GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Buildkite
  • Progressive rollouts and feature flags
  • Auto-rollback on regressions
  • Signed, attested, and SBOM-tagged releases
    •  
  
 
  
 
 
Server Management
 
Keep your infrastructure running smoothly
 
 
Managed Kubernetes, serverless on AWS Lambda, or a humble VPS — we run the boring but critical parts so you can focus on the product. Patching, scaling, backups, and a 24/7 on-call rotation when something goes wrong.
 
     
  • Kubernetes, ECS, and Lambda
  • Patch, backup, and capacity management
  • 24/7 on-call with a real engineer
  • Postmortems that actually change something
    •  
  
 
  
 
 
Security Audits
 
Identify and fix vulnerabilities
 
 
We do not sell scary reports — we sell fixed CVEs. Our security audits end with a prioritized remediation plan, a tracked set of pull requests, and a re-test. We work with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and the UAE PDPL.
 
     
  • Web, API, and cloud config audits
  • Pen testing with a real report
  • SOC 2 and ISO 27001 readiness
  • UAE PDPL and data residency review
    •

 FAQ 
Questions we hear most often
 
 
     
  •  
      Which cloud do you recommend?     
    It depends on your existing commitments, regulatory requirements, and team. We are agnostic across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Cloudflare. We will recommend the right one for your workload after a short architecture review.
     
     
  •  
      Can you take over an existing cloud setup?     
    Yes. We start with a paid audit — architecture, cost, security, and reliability scorecard — then propose a phased plan. We have rescued accounts with surprise bills, manual deploys, and a single point of failure or two.
     
     
  •  
      Do you offer 24/7 on-call?     
    We do. We pair with your team during business hours and own a real on-call rotation outside it. Response times are documented up front, and we run a quarterly chaos test to keep the runbooks honest.
     
     
  •  
      How do you handle data residency in the UAE?     
    All major providers now have UAE regions, and we design for residency from the first diagram. We have shipped UAE-only deployments for healthcare, education, and government clients and can walk you through the trade-offs.
